description: Update a meeting (partial) — reschedule (start_at/end_at) or cancel (status='cancelled'). Get the meeting_id from find_calendar_event; an id belonging to a calendar event is not accepted here, use update_calendar_event for those. Times without a UTC offset are read as wall-clock time in the caller's timezone (pass timezone, an IANA name, to override) — so '14:00' means 14:00 where the user is, not 14:00 UTC. NOTE: if the meeting has a video_provider link, reschedule it via add_meeting_video_link too (same provider) so the video meeting's own time gets updated — this tool only updates the CallPilotAI record.

meeting_id.description: ID of the meeting to change

name: update_meeting
